<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="he" dir="rtl"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>סבתא שולי · אלבום משפחתי</title>
<style>
:root{--text:#44352f;--muted:#84716b;--border:#eadbd1;--rose:#af7280;--cream:#f8f3ed;--paper:#fffdf9}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;font-family:Arial,'Noto Sans Hebrew',sans-serif;background:#f6efe8;color:var(--text);line-height:1.65}button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer}button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #bd7289;outline-offset:2px}h1,h2,h3,p{margin-top:0}h1,h2{font-family:Georgia,Arial,serif}h1{font-size:clamp(36px,6vw,70px);font-weight:500;line-height:1.25;margin:5px 0 8px}h2{font-size:clamp(27px,4vw,42px);font-weight:500}h3{font-size:21px}header{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 15% 30%,#f5d8d6 0,transparent 35%),linear-gradient(120deg,#fff9f1,#eedcd2);padding:48px 20px 31px;text-align:center;border-bottom:1px solid #e1cec0}header .eyebrow{color:#986b72;font-size:13px;font-weight:bold;letter-spacing:.12em}header p{font-size:17px;color:#806d64;margin:8px 0 0}nav{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;background:#fffaf5;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5;padding:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}nav button,.softbtn{border:1px solid #dfcec4;color:#73575b;background:white;padding:10px 19px;border-radius:25px}nav button.active{background:#986a76;border-color:#986a76;color:white}main{max-width:1140px;margin:auto;padding:32px 20px 100px}.sectionintro{margin:0 0 26px;color:var(--muted)}section[hidden]{display:none!important}.person{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:21px;box-shadow:0 9px 30px #4b2b2611;margin:0 0 22px;overflow:hidden}.person-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:245px 1fr;gap:23px;padding:20px;align-items:center}.person-cover{height:305px;max-width:245px;width:100%;object-fit:contain;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,#fae1d8,#eee1d5);border-radius:13px}.person small{color:#986a76;font-weight:bold}.person h3{font-size:30px;margin:6px 0}.person p{color:#756862}.thumbs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:13px}.thumb{border:2px solid transparent;border-radius:9px;padding:5px;width:102px;background:#f8eee7;color:var(--text)}.thumb[aria-pressed=true]{border-color:#b17283;background:#f4e0e5}.thumb img{height:85px;width:100%;object-fit:contain}.thumb span{display:block;font-size:11px;line-height:1.3}.story{border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding:26px 21px 28px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#fffbf6,#faece8);text-align:center}.story .eyebrow{color:var(--rose);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.08em;font-weight:bold}.story h3{font-size:31px;margin:4px 0}.story p{color:var(--muted)}.panels{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px;text-align:right}.panel{margin:0;background:white;border:1px solid var(--border);overflow:hidden;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 5px 14px #44333311}.panel button{border:0;padding:0;background:transparent;display:block;width:100%;cursor:zoom-in}.panel img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/2;object-fit:contain;display:block;background:#fff5ee}.panel figcaption{padding:12px 14px;font-size:14px;font-weight:bold}.panel figcaption b{display:inline-flex;border-radius:50%;background:#f4dfe4;color:#955267;width:24px;height:24px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-left:7px}.quotehero{max-width:850px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#fff8ee,#f5e5e9);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:26px;border-radius:20px;text-align:center;margin:0 auto 27px}.quotehero h3{color:#865461;font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,40px);margin:4px 0}.quotehero .imgbtn{padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;width:100%;cursor:zoom-in}.quotehero img{width:100%;display:block;border-radius:12px}.tagcloud{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:11px;max-width:820px;margin:auto}.tagcloud span{border:1px solid #e2c9c9;background:#fffcf8;padding:12px 19px;border-radius:99px;font-size:19px;color:#815565}.empty{text-align:center;background:#fffaf5;border:1px dashed #d9c9bf;border-radius:16px;padding:35px 20px}.momentform{max-width:650px;margin:22px auto;background:white;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:15px;padding:20px}.momentform input,.momentform textarea{width:100%;margin:5px 0 14px;border:1px solid #d6c8c1;border-radius:9px;padding:11px;font:inherit}.momentform label{display:block;font-weight:bold}.momentform button{background:#896574;color:white;padding:10px 18px;border:0;border-radius:25px}.moments{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}.memory{background:white;border-radius:15px;padding:16px;border:1px solid var(--border)}.memory img{display:block;width:100%;max-height:330px;object-fit:contain}.memory h3{margin:9px 0 5px}.memory p{color:var(--muted)}footer{text-align:center;padding:25px;background:#eee0d8;color:#85736c}dialog{border:0;border-radius:14px;padding:0;width:min(96vw,1190px);max-width:none;max-height:96vh;background:#1d1c1f;color:white}dialog::backdrop{background:#1a1619d9}.viewerhead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 15px}.viewerhead button{border:0;background:#4e484b;color:white;border-radius:8px;padding:4px 13px}#bigimg{max-height:calc(96vh - 115px);max-width:100%;width:100%;object-fit:contain;display:block}.viewerbuttons{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:15px;padding:10px}.viewerbuttons button{border:1px solid #777;background:#424045;border-radius:8px;color:white;padding:6px 13px}
@media(max-width:720px){main{padding:22px 12px 60px}.person-head{grid-template-columns:1fr}.person-cover{height:320px;max-width:100%}.panels,.moments{grid-template-columns:1fr}.thumb{width:calc(33.33% - 6px)}.thumb img{height:75px}.story{padding:23px 12px}nav button{padding:9px 12px;font-size:14px}}
</style></head><body><header><div class="eyebrow">אלבום של אהבה, זיכרונות ומשפחה</div><h1>סבתא שולי ♡</h1><p>הסיפורים הקטנים שנשארים איתנו תמיד</p></header>
<nav aria-label="מדורי האתר"><button class="active" data-tab="people">דמויות</button><button data-tab="memories">רגעים מהעבר</button><button data-tab="quotes">משפטי מחץ</button></nav>
<main>
<section id="people"><h2>האנשים שלנו</h2><p class="sectionintro">הדמויות והזיכרונות המשפחתיים</p>
<article class="person" id="malin"><div class="person-head"><img class="person-cover" id="malinBig" alt="מלין חן, דיוקן" src="data:image/webp;base64,
